title: CFI (Centre for Innovation)
summary: India's largest student-run innovation lab: 13 clubs, 6 competition teams, summer school.

posts.md:
## What is CFI?

**Centre For Innovation (CFI)** is the **largest student-run innovation lab in India**. It is housed in the **Sudha and Shankar Innovation Hub** and serves as a launchpad for students to transform their ideas into real products.

> **"Walk in with an idea, walk out with a product!"**

The CFI building is **alumni-funded**, reflecting the strong senior-junior and alumni network built through CFI clubs and competition teams.

## Can Students Join?

Yes! CFI is open to all students.

CFI consists of:

- **13 Clubs**
- **6 Competition Teams**

Applications for clubs are released during the **first semester**.

The application process includes:

- Filling out an application form (no prerequisites).
- Assessment of skills and eagerness to learn.
- An interview conducted by the respective club heads.

CFI has **no fixed timings** and is **open 24×7**, allowing students to work on projects whenever they wish.

## Life at CFI

CFI is a builders' paradise, bustling with activity throughout the day.

Students have dedicated workspaces for every club and competition team, where they work on innovative projects using the institute's infrastructure and funding support.

Projects undertaken at CFI often leave a lasting impact on students and continue to influence their careers even after graduation.

The Centre stands as a testament to engineering in its truest sense—building, innovating, and solving real-world problems.

## CFI Clubs

The clubs work throughout the year on multiple projects, with separate teams assigned to each project.

Some projects aim for **patents**, while many are showcased at **Open House**, an annual exhibition attended by professors, industry professionals, and media.

### Clubs at CFI

- 3-D Printing Club
- Aero Club
- AI Club
- Biotech Club
- Electronics Club
- Horizon
- i-Bot Club
- Mathematics Club
- Product Design Club
- Programming Club
- Team Envisage
- Team Sahaay
- WebOps and Blockchain Club

## Competition Teams

The competition teams represent **IIT Madras** at prestigious national and international competitions.

### Raftaar Formula Racing

Builds Formula-style race cars and represents IIT Madras in international Formula Student competitions.

### Team Abhiyaan

Develops intelligent, robust, precise, and safe autonomous ground navigation systems.

### Team Anveshak

Designs and builds remote-operated all-terrain rovers with robotic manipulators and diggers for harsh Martian conditions.

### Avishkar Hyperloop

Works on sustainable Hyperloop technologies aimed at revolutionizing transportation.

### Team Agnirath

Builds state-of-the-art solar-powered cars for a sustainable future.

### Team Abhyuday

Focused on rocketry and advancing space technology through student-led innovation.

## CFI Summer School

Apart from clubs and competition teams, CFI conducts a **Summer School**.

It helps students from both within and outside IIT Madras learn the basics of each club through concise introductory sessions, providing an overview of the work carried out at CFI.

## CFI Legacy

CFI is one of the strongest enablers of the builder culture at IIT Madras.

It provides students with the infrastructure, funding, and environment needed to transform ideas into impactful innovations.

One of CFI's most notable success stories is **Ather Energy**.

Founded by **Tarun Mehta** and **Swapnil Jain**, alumni of the Engineering Design Department at IIT Madras, Ather began as an electric vehicle prototype developed at CFI before growing into one of India's leading electric vehicle companies.

> **If you're passionate about building, innovating, and creating technology from scratch, CFI is the place to be.**
